budget_scope: Calibration and full execution combined; no amount consumed is asserted by this proposal.

ceilings.hard_stop: Stop accepting new retrievals at the applicable ceiling and finish already-open decisions; if counts fail, stop screening and repair the register.

ceilings.derivation: 60 cases x 6 variants x 3 repeat slots
ceilings.hard_stop: Stop scheduling before run 1081; halt if ledger counting fails.
Stop before call 1401. If automatic counts are unavailable, reconcile session/turn identifiers before more model work.
Stop at 8,000,000. If telemetry is unavailable, the call ceiling binds and human review occurs at 1,120 calls.
Stop at 40 active hours or end of calendar day 14 after the recorded approval timestamp, whichever is first. Repair incomplete timestamps before continuing.
Refuse a fourth active model worker; if concurrency cannot be observed, run sequentially.
Stop after two retries for an operation or forty overall; every retry must record a changed input, hypothesis, executor, or method.
Stop before exceeding USD 200. If pricing or cost telemetry is unavailable, calls and tokens bind and human approval is required at the token warning.

allocation_constraints: A deterministic evaluated run is recorded in the run ledger even when it consumes no model call.
The panel uses the three planned repeat slots as its three members; it does not create three panels per case.
Each configured case/variant/repeat operation may consume at most one model call unless a human-approved material deviation revises the budget arithmetic.
Model calls used during calibration count against the 1,400 total and must be entered before full execution begins.
Raising any hard ceiling requires a versioned deviation approved by the human owner.

assignments.scope: Freeze and govern protocol, eligibility, appraisal, extraction, coverage, stopping, and deviations; adjudicate borderlines and may pause work.
assignments.excluded_authority: Cannot approve budget, material scope, model substitution, protocol, or final acceptance.

assignments.scope: Reversible metadata normalization and first-pass triage after approval; sample at least 20 percent plus all borderline proposed exclusions.
assignments.excluded_authority: No final exclusion, appraisal conclusion, synthesis, or acceptance authority.

assignments.scope: Full-text eligibility, appraisal, and structured extraction under frozen instruments after approval.
assignments.excluded_authority: Borderline exclusions and high-impact negative evidence require method-lead adjudication.

assignments.scope: Read-only reconstruction of the named local gate boundary with path/digest provenance.
assignments.excluded_authority: Cannot mutate sources, infer unknowns as facts, or import external conclusions into local evidence.

assignments.scope: Construct approved corpus and execute frozen variants under blinding, versioning, randomization, raw retention, and deterministic scoring.
assignments.excluded_authority: Cannot view gold labels during gate runs, alter scorers after unblinding, waive deterministic failures, or exceed retry/budget ceilings.

assignments.executor: gpt-5.6-sol xhigh for final cross-source synthesis
assignments.scope: Quality-stratified comparative synthesis, findings, assurance tiers, and recommendations.
assignments.excluded_authority: Cannot alter source records, close own challenges, or accept the package.

assignments.scope: Challenge causal language, sufficiency, omissions, applicability, feasibility, and controls.
assignments.excluded_authority: Cannot author initial synthesis or unilaterally accept/reject the package.

assignments.executor: deterministic tools with assigned verifier judgment only where the plan requires it
assignments.scope: Deterministically verify artifacts, IDs, counts, citations, links, schemas, rendering, integrity, budgets, and dispositions.
assignments.excluded_authority: Cannot repair silently or waive failures.

assignments.scope: Approve protocol, budget, material deviations, model substitutions, residual risk, unresolved challenges, and final research.
assignments.excluded_authority: No authority is delegated to a model by silence.

handoff_order: Parallel evidence review, local analysis, and controlled evaluation
deviation_rule: No silent change to scope, eligibility, queries, instruments, schema, sample, variant, model, effort, budget, decision rule, or authority boundary. Log proposed changes before affected work; material changes require human approval and, when they alter the plan contract, a vN+1 plan.
